name: Aloo Matar
summary: Potatoes and peas in a cumin-spiced tomato gravy, served with rice. Cheap, vegan, and filling.

ingredients.name: chili powder (or cayenne for more heat)
russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 2 cm cubes

instructions: Cook the rice: 300 g rice with 600 mL water, simmered covered for 15 minutes, then rested 5 minutes.
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat. Cook the onion 8 minutes until golden. Add the garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then the cumin, coriander, turmeric, and chili for 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes and cook 5 minutes, stirring, until thick.
Add the potatoes, 1 tsp salt, and 400 mL water. Cover and simmer 15 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
Stir in the frozen peas and garam masala. Simmer uncovered 3–4 minutes. Serve with the rice.

glutenFree.notes: Potatoes, peas, tomatoes, rice, and spices are naturally gluten-free. Check the garam masala label for added flour.

budgetNotes: This is one of the cheapest dinners on the site at under $1.80 a serving.
Roti or chapati is the usual pairing. The Aloo Paratha dough (flour, water, salt) makes plain chapati for about $0.40.
Add a drained can of chickpeas ($1.50) if you want more protein.
